apply_hypersphere_normalization: normalize a PyTorch tensor onto a unit hypersphere by dividing by its L2 norm
apply_spherical_manifold: project a 2D tensor onto a spherical manifold using sin and cos of atan2 angles
apply_gumbel_softmax: sample from logits using the Gumbel-Softmax trick with configurable temperature and hard sampling
quantize_tensor_with_straight_through: quantize a tensor to discrete levels using straight-through estimator for gradient flow
categorical_discretization_with_gumbel: discretize categorical probabilities into continuous values using Gumbel sampling and linspace steps
